3 photographs attached, in order:

  3. elevated rooftop view of the great stage house and the green dome at left, overcast

json.notes: The Palais Garnier has a wide front block with a rusticated arcaded base and a tall Corinthian loggia above, plus two projecting end pavilions with arched pediments and gilded statue groups on top. The auditorium sits behind it under a green dome, and the tall stage house behind that has a big triangular gable. Side pavilions and low wings fill the rest of the footprint. I model the front facade, the green dome with its lantern, and the tall gabled stage house.
